content:
**Wrecking Ball** is an Intelligence-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Increased damage to world objects by +100%. Enables destroying of the player's own C.A.M.P. items.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 1 | You deal +100% damage to objects and now damage your own objects. | 00185995 | 

As of November 2024, Bethesda Game Studios reported Wrecking Ball as being the least used perk card in *Fallout 76*. [1]
